name: io.github.janfrl/mcp-abap-adt
description: ABAP ADT MCP server for reading SAP objects (programs, classes, tables, CDS) via ADT, with multi-system and OS keychain support

environmentVariables.name: SAP_URL
environmentVariables.description: Base URL of the SAP system, e.g. https://host:44300. Required unless systems are declared in a config file.

environmentVariables.name: SAP_ALLOW_SELF_SIGNED
environmentVariables.description: Last resort: true skips certificate verification. Internal company CAs need nothing - the OS trust store is loaded automatically.

environmentVariables.name: TLS_REJECT_UNAUTHORIZED
environmentVariables.description: Deprecated, inverted spelling of SAP_ALLOW_SELF_SIGNED. Set to 0 to accept self-signed certificates.

environmentVariables.name: SAP_ALLOW_FREE_SQL
environmentVariables.description: Set to false to forbid ad-hoc SELECT statements through the ExecuteQuery tool. Allowed by default.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_ABAP_ADT_CONFIG
environmentVariables.description: Path to a configuration file declaring several named SAP systems

environmentVariables.name: MCP_ABAP_ADT_CONFIG_JSON
environmentVariables.description: The whole configuration as JSON, so no file is needed. Takes the same object a config file holds.

environmentVariables.name: SAP_IMPORT_FIORI_SYSTEMS
environmentVariables.description: Set to true to adopt the systems saved by the SAP Fiori tools VS Code extension

environmentVariables.name: SAP_DEFAULT_SYSTEM
environmentVariables.description: Name of the system used when a tool call omits the system argument

environmentVariables.name: MCP_ABAP_ADT_DEBUG
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to trace every ADT call, on stderr and as MCP log notifications

environmentVariables.name: SAP_USE_SYSTEM_CA
environmentVariables.description: Set to false to keep the server on Node's bundled CA list instead of also trusting the OS trust store.
